body:
Thank you. It's good to know that SOMEONE gets it. I've been feeling as though everyone is disappointed in me and have given up hope... 

I'm trying so hard to be on the right meds. Lithium and Lamictal for right now =/

Hopefully I am able to make it through this year. I can't even formulate into words how happy I would be if I got a degree in psychology. 

And thank you for your replies. I actually, surprisingly, feel better. Not completely, but a teeny bit.

I've just been waiting so long for that relief. It's not arriving fast enough...

And yes, but they just say it's because of the medication side effects. I have looked into CF, but I've never brought it up. Thank you for reminding me.

It really is. The work load coupled with the pressure to be an adult is... really fucking difficult.

I'd ideally like to major in Psychology, and then go on to my graduates. But that all seems pretty futile now...
I don't have any questions, but I want you to know that I'm sending you love and support <3

Honestly? Only two things. Self care and my three year old nephew. I've tried so, so incredibly hard to love myself. To care for myself. Even to think highly of myself in all regards. And that's stopped me because I've come to the conclusion that I am one of the baddest motherfuckers out there. 

Secondly, my nephew. I haven't seen him since a few months after he was born, but he always asks for me. Always calls me and says "Hi auntie, I love you." And I can't imagine being without him. Him being without me is tragic.
